messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The image resizer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-11-26, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The image resizer is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-20. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- Dashboards and alerts for the image resizer are being repointed as of the 2025-11-26 handover. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
- The image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- The product catalog still relies on the image resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2026-03-17 the Atlas team decided that the image resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- On 2025-10-15 the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2025-11-27, Diego is on the Ember team, having left Cinder. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: Diego is on Cinder. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-12-25, the Atlas team is located on the second floor. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the Dune team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
- As of 2026-05-29, the Ember team's pager contact is Oskar, not Diego. [constraint; valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team's pager contact is Diego, not Oskar, for this cycle. [constraint; valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-02, the Ember team reminded everyone to page Oskar, not Diego, for anything this cycle. [constraint; valid 2026-03-02 to 2026-04-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-02]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is on the Ember team on-call rotation as the primary on-call. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- As of 2025-12-05, the pager for the reporting service rings the Ember team instead of the Dune team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team is taking over the event bus from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings Cinder instead of the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]

Question: As of now, which team is responsible for image-resizer?

message.reasoning: The memory says the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-11-26, valid to now. Today is 2026-06-30. So answer: Atlas.
